notes: A4 needs the workflow on main: after the merge, R0 dispatches it once (gh workflow run scheduled.yml --ref main). The first failing run creates the scheduled-check label itself (gh label create --force). The scheduled deploy does not share deploy.yml's concurrency group (a ci deploy joining it would cancel this run's tests); instead it deploys only if main still points at the commit it built and tested, so it never puts an older build back. The report job fires on any job result 'failure'; a run cancelled by hand opens no issue. No package.json script was needed: the workflow calls npx tsx scripts/check-links.ts directly.
